create_CamembertConfig: create a CamembertConfig instance with default almanach/camembert-base style configuration
initialize_CamembertModel: initialize a CamembertModel with random weights from a CamembertConfig instance
access_model_config: access the configuration object from an initialized CamembertModel instance
customize_CamembertConfig: customize CamembertConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
configure_Camembert_dropout: configure CamembertConfig with custom hidden_dropout_prob, attention_probs_dropout_prob, and classifier_dropout values
